title: Scripture and the Church
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Scripture and the church teaches that the people of God are gathered, nourished, corrected, ordered, and sent by the Word of God. The church does not stand over Scripture; it lives under Scripture for the glory of Christ.
summary: Scripture and the church teaches that the people of God are gathered, nourished, corrected, ordered, and sent by the Word of God. The church does not stand over Scripture; it lives under Scripture for the glory of Christ.
christFocus: Christ is the Head of the church, and He rules His people by His Word. Scripture reveals His Gospel, commands, mission, care, correction, and promises for the church He loves and preserves.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
The church is a people gathered around the apostles’ teaching, fellowship, breaking of bread, and prayers. From the beginning, the Word of God shaped the life, worship, doctrine, and mission of Christ’s people.

Scripture teaches the church how to conduct itself as the household of God. The church is not free to invent its identity, message, worship, leadership, discipline, or mission apart from the Word.

The public reading, teaching, preaching, singing, and application of Scripture are central to the church’s health. The Word of Christ must dwell richly among believers so they may teach and admonish one another in wisdom.

The church is built on the foundation of God’s revealed truth, with Christ Himself as the cornerstone. Scripture keeps the church centered on Him rather than on human tradition, preference, personality, or power.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Churches can drift when Scripture becomes secondary to programs, opinions, entertainment, politics, tradition, or growth strategies. A church may remain busy and religious while no longer being truly governed by God’s Word.

This doctrine protects the people of God. The church needs Scripture to define its Gospel, correct its sin, nourish its members, guard its doctrine, train its leaders, shape its worship, and send it in mission.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Submit church life to the Word of God. Choose worship, teaching, fellowship, service, leadership, correction, and mission that are shaped by Scripture. Do not look for a church merely by preference or popularity; look for a people who honor Christ by receiving, teaching, and obeying His Word.
